latest_release.name: v2.3.2
latest_release.body:
### TL;DR

🔒 This is a security release!

Fixes the following vulnerabilities:

- [Percent-encoded API path bypasses shop API ownership filters, exposing and modifying other customers' data](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-cqw6-3fwg-cfv4)
- [A disabled API stays reachable through a percent-encoded path](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-mw28-p745-4jrv)
- [Host header injection in the shop password reset e-mail link when the channel has no hostname](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-v78h-66q4-h9px)
- [Unpublished product reviews disclosed through the Shop API item endpoint](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-5mpg-w6q2-2vrw)
- [Promotion and coupon usage limit bypass via race condition in Sylius 2.3](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-h76r-rr27-3gm4)
- [Channel-based payment method restriction bypass on shop payment request API endpoint](https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/security/advisories/GHSA-ccgh-6w73-crf8)

## What's Changed
* [PaymentBundle] Return the latest payment request when several match the action, payment and method by @GSadee in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19302
* [UPMERGE] 2.2 -> 2.3 by @SyliusBot in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19305
* [UPMERGE] 2.2 -> 2.3 by @SyliusBot in https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/pull/19308


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sylius/Sylius/compare/v2.3.1...v2.3.2
